method: Built-in imagegen; one asset per type; municipality is style/camera reference
common: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE complete Ottoman-Aegean city-builder BUILDING PARCEL texture, landscape about 2.3:1 ratio. Input image is camera/material/framing reference only: replace ALL municipal architecture with the requested building. Orthographic high bird-eye FRONT-facing view; horizontal front/back edges, axis-aligned full rectangular footprint, NO diamond and NO floating model. The asset fills 100% of the image right up to ALL FOUR EDGES with real architecture, boundary walls and integral functional paved courtyard. No margin, no white background, no transparent pixels, no soil or empty land. Stone boundary integrated to edges, entire roof/body/courtyard/shadow stays inside rectangle. Full front building elevation compressed naturally by high camera. Large readily recognizable main building mass occupies most parcel, courtyard and covered wings fill the remainder. Same warm upper-left daylight, ivory limestone, muted terracotta, lead-gray roofing, fine realistic-stylized hand-painted texture as reference. Do NOT reuse palace twin towers or ornamental palace gate except when requested. No surrounding city, roads, other plots, UI, labels, captions, modern elements. Subject:
